title: Lead Data & AI Architect
description:
Lead Data & AI Architect - AWS - Agentic AI - Decision Intelligence - Fully Remote (UK) - Up to £110,000 + Bonus


We're partnering with an innovative AI software business helping enterprise organisations transform complex data into trusted, decision-grade intelligence.

We're seeking a Lead Data & AI Architect to help shape the next generation of analytics, AI and decision intelligence solutions. This is a unique opportunity to combine data architecture, technical leadership, customer engagement and AI strategy within a growing technology business.

The Role

You'll work closely with customers, product teams and technical stakeholders to design AI-ready data platforms, influence technical direction and establish trusted foundations for analytics and AI.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and evolving AWS-based data architectures
  • Supporting AI, Machine Learning and Agentic AI initiatives
  • Driving data governance, observability, quality and lineage standards
  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and stakeholders
  • Shaping architecture, tooling and best practices across the platform
  • Helping organisations operationalise AI in complex enterprise environments
What We're Looking For

You may currently be working as a:

  • Lead Data Architect
  • Data & AI Architect
  • Solutions Architect
  • Principal Consultant
  • Technical Architect
  • Platform Architect
  • Senior/Lead Data Engineer with strong architecture experience

Essential experience:

  • AWS architecture and cloud data platforms
  • SQL and modern data modelling
  • Production-grade data platform design
  • Data governance, quality and observability
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Experience influencing technical strategy and architecture decisions

Desirable:

  • AI, Machine Learning or Generative AI experience
  • Agentic AI, RAG or AI governance exposure
  • Customer-facing or consulting experience
  • Experience within regulated or security-conscious environments
Technology

AWS | Python | SQL | APIs | Data Platforms | Analytics Engineering | Data Governance | Machine Learning Infrastructure | Generative AI | Agentic Systems

Why Join?
  • Fully remote UK role
  • Up to £110,000 + bonus
  • High levels of ownership and autonomy
  • Significant influence over product and platform direction
  • Work on cutting-edge AI and decision intelligence solutions
  • Clear progression into broader technical leadership

If you're excited by the intersection of Data Architecture, AI, Governance and Customer Engagement, we'd love to hear from you.
